explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/945 (Erdős–Mirsky): F(x) is the maximal k such that there exist n+1, …, n+k ≤ x with τ(n+1), …, τ(n+k) all distinct; 'is it true that F(x) ≤ (log x)^{O(1)}?'. In Lean F x is the supremum of k admitting n with n + k ≤ x and τ injective on (n, n+k] (bounded by x, so a maximum), and Erdos945Prop says ∃ O : ℝ → ℝ bounded for large x with F x ≤ (log x)^{O x} eventually, i.e. F(x) ≤ (log x)^C for some constant C and all large x. Faithful.
